quests.title: Stamp mill and hand screen
quests.text: A plain-mined ore block gives a quarter of its metal. Crank ore through a stamp mill and sort it on a hand screen, then a shaking table or magnetic separator, and you get half.

tasks.text: Crush ore in the stamp mill

quests.title: The crusher line
quests.text: On 480 V three-phase: a grizzly over a jaw crusher, a double-deck screen, and a cone crusher for the screen's oversize, joined by belt conveyors with a conveyor drive on each run. Feed it ore blocks from an ore bin.

quests.title: Grind and float
quests.text: The screen's sand goes to a ball mill and cyclones; the mill's motor runs at medium voltage. Fines slurry on steel pipe to a conditioning tank with lime, xanthate and frother, then a flotation bank with an air blower touching it. A thickener and pressure filter pay three quarters of the metal.

quests.title: Leach the tails
quests.text: Flotation tails and sulfuric acid in a leach tank, washed in a CCD thickener, the pregnant liquor plated in an electrowinning bank. With scavenger cells, a regrind mill and cleaners the plant gets nearly all the metal.

quests.title: Concentrate to metal
quests.text: Set a concentrate dryer against the pressure filter and its copper goes to the smelter, not straight to ingots. The dryer feeds a flash smelting furnace (silica sand by hopper, pipeline gas), which makes matte for a Peirce-Smith converter on medium voltage. Pipe both furnaces' off-gas to an acid plant's converter: a smelter must not vent. The anode furnace fire refines the blister, the casting wheel casts 400 kg anodes, and the tankhouse refines them to cathodes. A blast furnace melts a cathode to two ingots. The line pays 97.5 % of the copper; the filter's direct ingots pay 85 %.

tasks.text: Smelt concentrate in the flash furnace
Pull a cathode from the tankhouse

quests.title: Zircon for the chlorinator
quests.text: Spirals take the heavy minerals out of the fines. The dry mill splits them: a gas-fired dryer, then roll magnets, high-tension rolls and the induced-roll magnet, which leaves zircon. Zircon concentrate goes by hopper into Wildcatter's chlorinator.

quests.title: Ferrosilicon and dense media
quests.text: Iron, sand and metallurgical coke make ferrosilicon, the dense medium: Wildcatter's submerged arc furnace makes the bags. In a DMS cyclone module heavy ore sinks and light rock floats off before it is ground; medium recovery wins the ferrosilicon back.

quests.title: The gyratory
quests.text: A wheel loader fills a haul truck, and the truck tips into the gyratory's dump pocket; the crusher takes 2,400 t/h onto a heavy belt to the coarse-ore stockpile, and reclaim feeders draw it to the SAG mill. Its motor runs at medium voltage, and it is built with cable.

quests.title: The cabled pit
quests.text: A pit switch house takes medium voltage in and hands it out on trailing cables. Click a reel on the house, then on a pit machine, to couple it, and close its outlet on the house's panel; each reel adds 400 m.

quests.title: Drill and blast
quests.text: Drill a pattern with the blasthole drill. The ammonia plant's nitric acid unit and neutraliser make AN solution, and its emulsion blender mixes it with diesel and emulsifier into matrix. Fill the emulsion truck at a matrix fill point from a tank of it; prime each hole with a detonator and cast booster, charge and stem it, log the holes, and fire from the blasting machine with its key.

quests.title: The rope shovel
quests.text: Build its crawlers, house, gantry, boom, dipper handle and dipper, couple a trailing cable and press RUN. It digs blasted rock and loads ultra haul trucks.

quests.title: The walking dragline
quests.text: Its tub, house, two shoes, mast, five boom sections and bucket, on a trailing cable. Set the strip on the tub's panel and press RUN: it drags the overburden off the seam and casts it aside, and walks on as it goes.

quests.title: On the levers
quests.text: Sit in the dragline's cab and touch a key: it is yours. W drags the bucket in through the bank, A and D swing the house (it coasts: brake early), jump hoists, sprint lowers. Hoisted and loaded, S pays out the drag and the bucket tips. Get out, or hold sprint 2 s, and the job carries on.

quests.title: Watch the wall
quests.text: A highwall cracks before it slides, and a prism on its bench moves before the cracks show. Place slope prisms on a pit's benches and spoil, and a survey station that can see them; wire its ALARM to stop the dragline or shovel. With the world rule slope_failures on, it is what stands between you and a slide.
